caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a brown metal caliper or measuring instrument, displayed against a plain, light beige background. The object consists of two long, flat arms that are hinged together at the bottom, forming a V-shape. At the upper end, each arm curves outward and upward to form two symmetrical, rounded arches, each with a circular fastener or rivet depicted on them. There are additional circular markings or bolts distributed along the arms and the curved sections. A horizontal bar connects the two curved upper sections, and the overall color of the object is a uniform, textured brown, suggesting a metallic or rusted appearance. The background is entirely unadorned, focusing attention solely on the object.
title: Hinge
